testCase.name: Navigation Argument Mismatch
testCase.description: Runtime crash due to missing/wrong navigation arguments

expectedFix.explanation: Add userId argument to navigation call

agent_response.rootCause: NavHost in MainActivity.kt line 67 expects required argument "userId" (type: String) defined in navigation.xml line 23, but calling code at HomeFragment.kt line 89 passes no arguments.
fixGuidelines: 1. Add argument to navigation call in HomeFragment.kt line 89: findNavController().navigate(R.id.action_home_to_profile, bundleOf("userId" to currentUserId))
2. Verify navigation.xml line 23 defines required argument: <argument android:name="userId" app:argType="string" />
3. Test navigation flow: Run app, navigate from HomeFragment to ProfileFragment - should pass userId correctly, verify in ProfileFragment onCreate() with arguments?.getString("userId")
